shortBio.en: AC/DC bassist from 1977; pocket playing under the Young brothers’ grind.
shortBio.zh: 1977 年起 AC/DC 贝斯；在 Young 兄弟碾磨下的口袋拍演奏。

body.en: Joins before Highway to Hell. Eighth-note lock with Phil Rudd. Retires from touring mid-2010s, returns selectively.
body.zh: Highway to Hell 前加入。与 Phil Rudd 锁八分音符。2010 年代中期退出巡演，选择性回归。
